briefdescription.para: Val - The value that is live out of the block.
Offset - The byte offset in Val that is interesting for the load query.
V1, V2 - The dominating non-clobbered values of SelectVal.
Emit code at the specified insertion point to adjust the value defined here to the specified type.
Represents a particular available value that we know how to materialize.

detaileddescription.para: Materialization of an AvailableValue never fails. An AvailableValue is implicitly associated with a rematerialization point which is the location of the instruction from which it was formed.
